dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Interlocking irregular polygons and closed loops with high-contrast, serrated light-grey borders surrounding dark, low-intensity centers. The transition at the edge is abrupt, transitioning from peak luminance to deep shadow over a narrow pixel range.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, high-luminance pixel clusters distributed unevenly across the mid-section. A notable concentration of solid-light-colored pixels is visible on the anterior dorsal region, lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest annuli on the mid-lateral flank form an elongated scalene triangle. A secondary cluster of four smaller blobs on the posterior dorsal area forms a tight, irregular quadrilateral.
